meta.notes: ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen Image 2.1)' template (image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit.json) without its optional prompt-enhancement encoder: UNETLoader → QwenImage21Cache, CLIPLoader type qwen_image, TextEncodeQwenImage21 (resolution 0 keeps the inputs' sizes) whose grouped `images` input takes the picture as images.image_1 and up to nine references as images.image_2…images.image_10 (the official template's limit of ten images); its third output is the empty latent sized to image_1. KSampler euler/simple 25 steps CFG 1, VAEDecode. The official notes say to name the images in the prompt as <image1>, <image2>, …; image 1 is the picture being edited. References not given are pruned with their LoadImage node. Verified against a live server's /object_info on 2026-10-11.
